rics.description: BIS, Nominal Broad Effective Exchange Rate Index
rics.meaning: BIS Nominal Broad Effective Exchange Rate Index for CNY — trade-weighted CNY against a basket of trading partners' currencies in nominal terms. The PBoC also publishes its own trade-weighted index (CFETS RMB Index) with similar weights.
rics.how_to_use: Better than USD/CNY alone for CNY competitiveness — captures moves vs JPY, EUR, KRW, SGD (key trade partners). Falling NEER = CNY weakening on trade-weighted basis. The PBoC explicitly targets stability against the basket post-2015 reform.

rics.description: BIS, Real Broad Effective Exchange Rate Index
rics.meaning: BIS Real Broad Effective Exchange Rate Index for CNY — trade-weighted CNY adjusted for relative inflation against trading partners. Shows true CNY competitiveness.
rics.how_to_use: Most analytically meaningful FX gauge. CNY's real EER appreciated through 2010s as China grew faster than peers; reversed post-2022 amid CNY weakness + China deflation. Watch real EER trends for CNY structural overvaluation/undervaluation signals.

rics.description: Import, digital program-controlled telephone or telegraph switch, Exchange Rates & Operations, Monthly, China Customs
rics.meaning: China Imports: digital program-controlled telephone or telegraph switch, Exchange Rates & Operations, Monthly, China Customs. Detailed import series by product/category from China Customs.
rics.how_to_use: Customs publishes detailed monthly bilateral and product-level import data. Major Chinese imports: integrated circuits, crude oil, iron ore, soybeans, copper, machinery. Track monthly YoY changes for cycle signal.

rics.description: Bank sales (foreign currency), Bank's own business
rics.meaning: China FX Market: Bank sales (foreign currency), Bank's own business. FX market trading data — spot, forward, swap activity.
rics.how_to_use: PBoC and SAFE manage CNY market through a combination of mid-point fix, intervention, capital controls. Forward rates signal expected appreciation/depreciation.

rics.description: Exchange rate RMB/USD
rics.meaning: Exchange rate RMB/USD — companion CNY/USD reference. Same conceptual measure as aCNXRUSD with potentially different vintage.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check against aCNXRUSD. Use whichever has fresher data; both track the daily CNY-USD spot rate.

rics.description: Exchange rate, Hong Kong dollar to USD
rics.meaning: Hong Kong Dollar to USD exchange rate — included in China dataset due to HKD's tight peg (HKD pegged to USD at 7.75-7.85). HKMA defends the peg via convertibility undertakings.
rics.how_to_use: Track for HK monetary-policy stress signals. Persistent trading at 7.85 (weak side) signals Hong Kong outflows; HKMA buys HKD/sells USD to defend. Critical for Hong Kong financial stability and offshore CNH market.

rics.description: Exchange rate, Middle price of USD to RMB
rics.meaning: Mid-Price of USD-CNY — the daily PBoC reference fix (zhōngjiānjià). Set at 09:15 CST and used as the center of the daily ±2% trading band.
rics.how_to_use: The PBoC's official signaling tool. Sharp moves in the fix (relative to market) signal policy intent — weaker-than-expected fix is depreciation guidance; stronger-than-expected is appreciation guidance. Markets watch the 'counter-cyclical factor' commentary in PBoC quarterly reports.

rics.description: Foreign exchange forward transaction volume, US dollar and yuan
rics.meaning: China FX Market: Foreign exchange forward transaction volume, US dollar and yuan. FX market trading data — spot, forward, swap activity.
rics.how_to_use: PBoC and SAFE manage CNY market through a combination of mid-point fix, intervention, capital controls. Forward rates signal expected appreciation/depreciation.

rics.description: Foreign exchange reserves
rics.meaning: Foreign Exchange Reserves — release-vintage version of total FX reserves. Cross-listed in exchange-rates dataset.
rics.how_to_use: Cross-check against aCNFXMAA. SAFE publishes FX reserves monthly with a 1-week lag.

rics.description: CHINESE YUAN TO US DOLLAR (AVERAGE AMOUNT)
rics.meaning: Chinese Yuan (Renminbi) per US Dollar — the headline USD/CNY spot rate. The PBoC sets a daily mid-point fix at 09:15 CST around which the onshore CNY is allowed to trade within ±2%.
rics.how_to_use: THE China FX rate. Recent range 6.4-7.4. The PBoC manages CNY against a basket but DXY/USD-CNY is the most-watched cross. Onshore CNY (CNY) and offshore CNH typically trade within ~50 bps; wider spreads signal capital-control stress. Pair with FX reserves (aCNCRESA) for intervention-intensity signals.
